_meta.kb_scoring_method: within-modality tie-aware percentile; pooled rollup; nonparametric bootstrap CI (B=2000, per-key seed 42)
_meta.metric_note: kb_score is the mean within-dataset tie-aware percentile (1=best), strictly within modality; never compare across modalities.
_meta.rollup_note: A modality rollup pools every per-dataset percentile across metrics; its kb_score is that pooled-sample mean (CI drawn from the same distribution), not a mean of per-metric kb_scores.
